commitments.target: Customer Support Chats and Call Transcripts
commitments.detail: Vendor must delete all customer support chat and call transcript data within 30 days of request.
Vendor is not permitted to use any customer support chat or call transcript data for model training.
Vendor must maintain cyber insurance coverage of at least $500,000.
Vendor must include the company as an additional insured party under its insurance policy.
Vendor must allow the company to conduct an annual audit of the vendor's handling of customer support chat and call transcript data.
